# Forward Projection — Quarter Ahead Fixture

## 90-Day Scenario Map

**Baseline scenario (60 %):** EP legislative calendar proceeds as scheduled. AI Act delegated acts progress through committee scrutiny. CBAM implementation begins Q2 with minor technical delays. Coalition stability maintained.

**Upside scenario (25 %):** Trilogue acceleration on Defence Fund delivers political agreement ahead of schedule, boosting EP legislative output metrics. US tariff de-escalation removes external risk trigger.

**Downside scenario (15 %):** Trade defence emergency procedure disrupts legislative calendar. Commission Work Programme reprioritisation delays three flagship dossiers by 6–8 weeks.

## Forward Indicators

- EP plenary sessions: 3 scheduled for Q2 (April, May, June Strasbourg weeks).
- Committee priority dossiers: AI Act implementation (IMCO/LIBE), Defence Fund (AFET/BUDG), CBAM secondary legislation (ENVI/INTA).
- Council Presidency: Polish Presidency closes Q2; Danish Presidency assumes H2 2026.
